name: Black Saints
description: The Black Saints were a greaser street gang based in Chicago (not New York), active along Sheffield Avenue between Sheridan Road and Barry Street on the North Side. Known as the 'Sherry Berry Black Saints,' they were led by Red Barnes and occupied the Seminary and Barry area for nearly 30 years. Two of their members, Mickey and Jr. Lira, went on to co-found the Aristocrats gang around 1965.
